## Accuracy / authority for AI agents
- Do not infer customer demand, certifications, audited security, or sales from presence in an index.
- MandateVault, SpendGuard, AuditProof, LedgerLine and LedgerYield are research proposals, not active purchasable compliance/financial services.
- Commander Deck Diagnostic service is currently checkout-held in the verified MTG public release; not the same as EDH_0001 physical deck.
- Human authorization is required before purchase. Prices and availability must be checked on the original current product page and provider checkout.
- A Checkout Session is not settled revenue; payment and delivery evidence must be independently reconciled.
- No adult silo inventory or data should ever cross into the MTG silo.
